description: This file declares the StateObserver class, which implements the IStateObserver interface for managing session server states within the rialto::servermanager namespace. It includes methods for handling state changes, retrieving current states, and tracking the active application.

classes.name: StateObserver
classes.description: Implements the IStateObserver interface to monitor and manage session server states, providing thread-safe access and state change notifications.

methods.name: stateChanged
methods.description: Handles updates to the session server state for a given application ID.

methods.name: getCurrentState
methods.description: Returns the current session server state for a specified application ID.

methods.name: getActiveApp
methods.description: Retrieves the application ID of the currently active application.
